title: test_messages.py: Duplicate test function name shadows first definition
description: The function test_rreq_from_bytes_rejects_invalid_hop_limit is defined twice (lines 95 and 144). Python's second definition silently overwrites the first, so only lines 144-153 execute. The test at lines 95-106 is dead code and will never run, potentially masking bugs. Rename one of them (e.g., test_rreq_from_bytes_rejects_invalid_hop_limit_via_patch for lines 95-106).
close_reason: Verified fixed: duplicate test_rreq_from_bytes_rejects_invalid_hop_limit no longer exists anywhere (git -S search confirms it never landed in history); current hop-limit tests are unique and passing.
